title: Extract acceptance CLI read decoding from the large API module with explicit caller ownership
outcome: A focused module owns acceptance CLI read decoding and states which callers and publication policies it serves, without changing their semantics.
acceptance: Move the read decoder/seam and any appropriately shared fixed diagnostic policy into a focused module with an ownership header; the API module delegates without coupling unrelated callers to evaluator recovery publication policy.

Behavioral tests preserve parent/settings unsupported-operation and user-refusal handling, and evaluator recovery confidentiality/classification; no new CLI, environment or authority override is introduced.
